definition: Average velocity is the total displacement divided by the total time taken.

worked_examples.problem_statement: Calculate the average velocity of a car that travels 100 meters in 20 seconds.
solution_steps: Identify the displacement (100 meters) and time (20 seconds).
Use the formula for average velocity.

common_errors: Using total distance instead of displacement.
visual_metaphor: A car moving on a straight road.
